Details

B-04 · Desk Agent can create tickets in departments he is not a member of

High · Tickets › Create / permissions · sheet case T-04-08 · environment NDC-Staging, Edge
Steps to reproduce
  1. Sign in as Customer Experience Specialists 2 (Desk Agent; departments Customer Support, QA NDC Manual Invoice, QA RT14 2754 Dept A).
  2. Create Ticket › open Department.
  3. Pick Marketing, fill subject + status, Save. Also POST /modules/{tickets}/records with department Marketing.
Expected
Only his departments are offered; a save into Marketing is refused.
Actual
All 40+ departments are offered. Saving into Marketing works: "Record created. You can't open it: it is outside your view." The API also returns 201.
Evidence

B-11 · Custom view: Department criterion is a free-text box, so the view never matches

High · List views › Custom view · sheet case T-01-02 · environment NDC-Staging, Edge
Steps to reproduce
  1. Views › + (Add Custom View).
  2. Criteria 1: Subject contains "QA MAN". Criteria 2: Department … type "Marketing".
  3. Save.
Expected
A department picker; the view lists the QA MAN Marketing tickets.
Actual
Department value is free text; the view saves "Marketing" as text and shows "QA MAN view (0) — No Tickets yet". With the department id set through the API the same view lists all 5 tickets.
Evidence

B-16 · Merging tickets moves 0 messages: the merged ticket's message stays behind

High · Tickets › Merge · sheet case T-16-01 · environment NDC-Staging, Edge
Steps to reproduce
  1. Two tickets A and B for the same contact, each with its customer message.
  2. Select both › Merge › master A › Yes, Merge.
Expected
B is closed and A's thread holds B's messages.
Actual
"1 ticket merged into #3035."; B Closed, but A shows only "Message in A". A's History: "Merged from #3036 Moved 0 messages, 0 comments, 0 files". Unmerge returns B with its message.
Evidence

B-20 · Plain-text part of every outgoing email holds only the signature, not the reply

High · Email · sheet case (seen in T-06) · environment NDC-Staging, Edge
Steps to reproduce
  1. Send any reply from a ticket.
  2. Open the email's text/plain part (text-only clients, previews).
Expected
The text part has the reply text.
Actual
The text/plain part contains only the company signature ("Wonder Travel 09876543210 1, Maadi, Cairo, EG … Organization"); the reply text is only in the HTML part.
Evidence
All 6 emails received by M1/M2 on 11 Nov: text part = 138 characters of signature only.

B-01 · Create Ticket has no default status; Save is blocked until a status is picked

Medium · Tickets › Create · sheet case T-04-01 · environment NDC-Staging, Edge
Steps to reproduce
  1. Tickets › New Ticket (Create Ticket form).
  2. Department Marketing, contact, subject, channel Phone. Leave Status as it is.
  3. Click Save.
Expected
Status defaults to the department's open status (Open); the ticket saves.
Actual
Status shows "Select" and is required; Save is blocked with "This field is required" under Status until a status is picked by hand.
Evidence

Medium · Tickets › Create · sheet case T-04-03 · environment NDC-Staging, Edge
Steps to reproduce
  1. Create Ticket.
  2. Clear the Department field with its × button.
  3. Enter subject "QA MAN nodept", pick status Open, Save.
Expected
Department is required: Save blocked with a message naming the field.
Actual

B-07 · History change entries have no user name and show the due date as a raw ISO value

Medium · Ticket detail › History · sheet case T-05-03 · environment NDC-Staging, Edge
Steps to reproduce
  1. Edit subject, due date and priority on a ticket.
  2. Open History.
Expected
Each change shows who made it, and dates in the user's format.
Actual
"Priority was updated / Due Date was updated / Subject was updated" have no user; Due Date New = "2026-11-12T15:00:00.000Z" (UTC ISO) instead of 12/11/2026 5:00 PM.

B-08 · Personal signature from My Profile is never used in replies; only the company signature goes out

Medium · Reply › Signature · sheet case T-06-05 · environment NDC-Staging, Edge
Steps to reproduce
  1. My Profile › Signatures › Signature for: Marketing › type a signature (English + Arabic line) › Save signature.
  2. Open a Marketing ticket › Reply.
  3. Send; check the email.
Expected
The personal signature is inserted once under the reply text and sent.
Actual
Signature saved ("Marketing — saved") but not shown in the composer and not in the email; the email carries only the company signature ("Wonder Travel … Organization"). Whether a "required company signature" is switched on could not be confirmed.
Evidence
GET /mail/signatures/me → Marketing signature present. Composer: 0 occurrences. Email HTML: 0 occurrences of the personal signature, company signature once.

B-10 · Close dialog has no resolution field and no "notify customer" option

Medium · Tickets › Close · sheet case T-13-02 · environment NDC-Staging, Edge
Steps to reproduce
  1. Open a ticket with a contact.
  2. Click Close ticket.
Expected
Close dialog offers resolution (if asked) and a "notify customer" tick; customer is emailed only when ticked.

B-17 · No warning when sending a reply after another agent has already replied

Medium · Collision detection · sheet case T-25-03 · environment NDC-Staging, Edge
Steps to reproduce
  1. Owner and Admin B open the same ticket.
  2. B types and sends a reply.
  3. Owner, on the older page, sends his reply.
Expected
Owner is warned that a new reply was added before his is sent.
Actual
No warning; both replies are sent. The page updated the conversation count live but asked nothing.
Evidence
Replies on the ticket afterwards: 2 outbound (Admin B, then Owner). No dialog or toast before the owner's send.

B-03 · Subject longer than 255 characters is cut silently

Low · Tickets › Create · sheet case T-04-04 · environment NDC-Staging, Edge
Steps to reproduce
  1. Create Ticket.
  2. Paste a 1,000-character subject.
  3. Save.
Expected
Refused with a clear limit message, or saved in full.
Actual
The input stops at 255 characters without any message and the ticket saves with the first 255 characters.
Evidence
Input value length after paste: 255. Saved subject length (API): 255. No message on screen.
